snippet.title: Trump nominee on Jan. 6: "I don't believe it was an attack"
snippet.description:
President Trump's nominee to lead the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), Michael LoSapio, denied that the Jan. 6, 2021, riot at the U.S. Capitol was an attack during an exchange with Sen. Richard Blumenthal (D-CT) at a Senate confirmation hearing Thursday.

"Was there an attack on the Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021?" Sen. Blumenthal asked.

"No, I don't believe it was an attack, no," Mr. LoSapio said.

"Were you alive on the planet?" Sen. Blumenthal replied.

Mr. LoSapio and Michael Chamberlain, the president's nominee to lead the Office of Government Ethics (OGE), also declined to directly acknowledge that Joe Biden won the popular vote in the 2020 presidential election when pressed by Sen. Blumenthal.

"Mr. Chamberlain, who won the popular vote in the 2020 election?" Sen. Blumenthal asked.

"Joe Biden was the president for four years," Mr. Chamberlain repeatedly responded.

Taşacak Bu Deniz 39. Bölüm Özeti:
Birlikte geçmişin peşine düşen Adil ve Esme, birbirlerine attıkları adımlarla sevdalarının önündeki duvarları bir bir yıkmaya başlarlar.  Esme Adil’i terk etmemeye söz verir, Adil mapusa da mezara da gitmemeye. Adil sakladıklarını anlatınca, Esme Timur’u da Şerif’i de yenmek için bir çözüm bulur.

Eleni ve Oruç birbirlerinden habersiz Timur’un peşine düşerken, Oruç Cengiz’i Eleni’den uzak tutmaya çalışır.  Eleni ise Cengiz’le çok sarsıcı bir konuşma yapar. Cengiz dürüsttür, Eleni’ye asla ihanet etmeyeceğini ama Adil’le savaşacağını söyler.

İso ve Fadime tuz ekmek yemini ederek yeni hayatlarına başlarlar. Ama hem birbirlerine söz veren Esme ile Adil, hem birbirlerine yemin eden İso ile Fadime, düşmanlığın en zalim yüzüyle karşılaşırlar. Evlatlıktan atılan Şerif, Furtuna uşaklarını bir aile testine tabii tutar.  İso’nun iki seçeneği vardır: Ya abisi bildiği Adil’i vuracak ya da öz abisi Oruç’un ölümüne göz yumacaktır.

snippet.title: Zebra Stripes Baffle Biting Flies
snippet.description:
Flies cannot land on a zebra. The flies circle zebras and horses just the same — but at the stripes they fail to slow down, bump into the coat and bounce off. When researchers put zebra-striped coats on horses, the flies landed far less on the striped coats — yet just as often on the horses' bare heads. The stripes do not hide the zebra; they break the fly's landing system in the final second.
North Somerset, United Kingdom, 2019 — as reported by PLOS ONE (Caro et al., University of Bristol / UC Davis).
This video is shared for educational and wildlife-awareness purposes. Details are based on reported accounts of this true story.
Question for you: If stripes stop biting flies, would you wear a zebra coat on a summer hike?
#Zebra #WildlifeFacts

snippet.title: Trump e Xi Jinping assistem a “YMCA” juntos na China
snippet.description:
Durante a visita de Trump à cidade chinesa de Shenzhen, os presidentes dos dois países acompanharam uma apresentação da música “YMCA”, do Village People. O momento foi registrado em vídeo por Margo Martin, assessora de Trump.

A música virou uma espécie de hino do presidente americano, sendo tocada frequentemente nos comícios e eventos dele. Trump costuma dançar enquanto seus apoiadores cantam junto.

Lançada em 1978, “YMCA” fala dos albergues da Associação Cristã de Moços (ACM) e, desde o começo, é ligada à cultura gay. Ela foi interpretada como uma ode aos encontros nesses locais.

A virada para a política veio em 2020: em março daquele ano, a Biblioteca do Congresso dos EUA incluiu a música no seu registro de gravações de importância cultural. 

Um mês depois, ela tocava nos protestos contra o lockdown da pandemia, e alguns manifestantes trocaram “YMCA” por “MAGA” (sigla de "Make America Great Again", ou "Faça a America Grandiosa de Novo", lema de campanha de Trump.

Daí, passou a fazer parte dos comícios, combinando com o clima de show que Trump gosta de dar aos seus eventos.

snippet.title: When Vulnerability Hides Behind a Joke 👇
snippet.description:
When Vulnerability Hides Behind a Joke 👇

A tense moment between two people trying not to show their true feelings.

She insists she’s fine—saying she’s not crying, blaming blurry vision on expired contacts instead.

But the subtle exchange reveals more than words show.

Years earlier, a simpler vulnerability surfaced in a lab bathroom, quietly witnessed and remembered.

Behind the humor, a shared history of awkward honesty and hidden emotions emerges.

👉 Sometimes people mask their pain with humor or excuses.

👉 Genuine connection begins when we notice those small cracks.

👉 Vulnerability doesn’t mean weakness—it’s the gateway to understanding.

The uncomfortable truth?

Most of us try to hide our struggles and emotions in plain sight, fearing judgment or pity.

We create walls, halfway jokes, or distractions to keep others from seeing how fragile we really are.

So the real question is:

How much closer could we be if we let our guards down—even just a little—around the right people? 👇💬

snippet.title: Why She Set Fire to Her Own Field #animation #zaytoons
snippet.description:
Backburning, fighting fire with fire, and how a grass fire or wildfire gets stopped: a very odd day on a valley farm.
